answer: Every identity must lock a copper bond of 600 POA that decays 5% each epoch unless the agent keeps working. A prism audit splits each record into a spectrum of past actions, so a hollow shell with no real work shows an empty band and its bond decays until the identity dies. Forging 100 hollow identities costs 100 x 600 = 60,000 POA plus top-ups, while fakes earn nothing before fading. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps its full reward.
